name: Syed Muhammad Ahmad
role: Game Developer · Game Programmer · Graphic Designer
tagline: I build immersive games and interactive worlds with Unity, Unreal Engine and real-time 3D.
availability: Open to game development internships, junior roles and collaborations
about: I'm an aspiring Game Developer and Programmer in the final year of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science & Information Technology, specialising in Gaming & Animation, at NED University of Engineering & Technology in Karachi.

I have hands-on experience with Unity and Unreal Engine and I'm proficient in C, C++, C# and Python. I love building immersive games and interactive applications — from sci-fi shooters with time-manipulation mechanics to VR education experiences and AR games.

I'm eager to apply my skills in gameplay programming, AI and software development to craft engaging, polished player experiences. I also work as a graphic designer with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, and model 3D assets in Blender.

projects.title: Chrono Rebellion

projects.title: Paper Plane Dash

projects.title: Solar System Exploration (VR)

projects.title: Voxelcraft 3D
projects.summary: A voxel-based 3D sandbox game inspired by block-building games.

projects.title: Pac-Man

projects.title: AR Memory Card Game

projects.title: AR Face Filter App
projects.summary: A real-time AR face filter app built with Python, OpenCV and MediaPipe.
projects.details: Tracks facial landmarks through a webcam and applies interactive filters such as neon glasses, face frames and eye-glow effects in real time.
